latest_cos_commentary.headline: Branch is a workforce financial-infrastructure vendor offering earned wage access and digital tip payouts, with Pizza Ranch as a named corporate customer.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Competes on back_office/payroll-adjacent capabilities (tips distribution, earned wage access) that can integrate with or substitute for features in a POS/payments provider's payroll and tip-management tools.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Active in EWA product expansion (a new flex model and direct delivery options per a 2026 release) as EWA adoption grows industry-wide.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Where a prospect already offers Branch EWA/tips to staff, treat it as a payroll-adjacent integration point rather than a POS displacement target.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: Named restaurant-customer evidence is limited to one brand (Pizza Ranch) found in this pass; broader restaurant-market penetration is not independently confirmed.
